children: Jordan's annual inflation rate accelerated for the first time in four months to 2.73% in September 2026, up slightly from a four-month low of 2.66% in August. It was the highest inflation rate since June, with transportation prices making the largest contribution to inflation, at 1.13 percentage points.
Jordan will raise fuel prices in October after freezing them in September despite soaring global crude prices.
However, price declines in several food categories helped offset inflationary pressures during September.
For the first nine months of the year, the inflation rate averaged 2.26%, with rent being the largest contributor to inflation, adding 0.72 percentage points to the overall rate.
On a monthly basis, the CPI rose 0.16% in September, marking the first monthly increase in three months, after falling 0.25% in August.

title: Jordan Inflation Rate Hits 3-Month High
